summary: More Ansible 12 community.general deprecations: sensu_silence and sensu_subscription (use sensu.sensu_go), the slack prepend_hash default, the stackpath_compute inventory, and the yaml callback, which is removed early in community.general 12.0.0 in favour of result_format=yaml in ansible.builtin.default.
questions: When is the community.general yaml callback removed?
Why was the yaml callback removed early?
What replaces the yaml stdout callback?
